upstream_tests.collection_command: uv run --project <frozen-source> --with pytest --with cherrypy --with 'cheroot>=11.1.2' pytest --collect-only -q -o addopts='' -p no:cacheprovider tests
upstream_tests.test_command: uv run --project <frozen-source> --with pytest --with cherrypy --with 'cheroot>=11.1.2' pytest -q -o addopts='' -p no:cacheprovider tests

collection_policy: Every scenario emits one unique leaf and collection mismatch is fatal.
risk_adaptation: Live server and Redis tests are not scored. Their underlying cache decisions and storage contracts are exercised with prepared requests, memory responses, injected time, and temporary files.
